<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-API-003</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Using the REST API</b></div><div class="fact"><small>HTTP status</small><b>404</b></div><div class="fact"><small>API error code</small><b>32</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Red notice in the web UI; REST API</b></div></div>

## Why it happens

- The item was deleted.
- The ID belongs to another tenant or customer, which you cannot see.
- A dashboard, rule chain or export still refers to an item by an old ID, for example after it was imported from another server.

## Fix it

Check the ID. In a dashboard, open the alias or widget that refers to the item and select it again. In a rule chain, open the node that names it and select it again.

## Check that it worked

The page or call works.
